title: Pakistan Plans EV Fast Chargers Every 50 KM on Highways
excerpt: The government plans to establish around 3,000 public electric vehicle charging stations across the country by 2030.
body_html:
The government has announced plans to establish public electric vehicle charging stations along major highways and motorways. Under the initiative, fast chargers will be installed every 50 kilometers to support electric vehicle adoption.

According to the Ministry, the project aims to set up approximately 3,000 public electric vehicle charging stations nationwide by the year 2030. The infrastructure development is designed to address range anxiety for drivers traveling across major routes and to encourage the transition toward cleaner transportation options within the country.
